question: How did Brittney Murphy achieve top 10 agent status at Matt Curtis Real Estate in just two years as a new agent?

question: What key principle has Brittney Murphy learned about discipline and success in real estate?
transcript_excerpt: Murphy emphasizes that discipline equals freedom in real estate.
